title: Silent drift is detected and prevented
statement: T020 must guard the decoder's declared member, vocabulary, pattern, ordering-key, and numeric-range tables against the committed normative plan schema; guard the plan-version constant, the closed digest sub-schema, the canonical-body/digest rule, and the anchored T017 fixtures against silent change; and detect drift fail-closed.
applicability: X-Verse capability 007 Profile/plan schema and digest contract.
verification_intent: Refined by T020-SR-003; verified by the T20Drift CTest cases and the T020 pytest fixture-digest case.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: the decoder's declared tables are asserted equal to the committed activation-plan.schema.json for the 16 required members, every closed enum, the patterns, the collection keys, the minItems minimums, and the numeric ranges.
AC-2: the closed $defs/digest sub-schema is asserted equal to the decoder's embedded-digest rule and a violated embedded digest is rejected.
AC-3: the plan-version const, the domain separator, and each committed fixture's canonical body/digest are pinned against golden values.
